description:
VeilsGalore is a bridal accessory retailer with a focus on helping brides. We specialize in wedding veils and bridal hair & jewelry accessories. You can express your creative spirit through our shop, where you can find one or several products that are just right for you. With our large selection of trending products, you're likely to find something that you'll love. 


We also offer special deals from time to time on a variety of wedding jewelry. These specials can be seen on our Social page

VeilsGalore Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Welcome to VeilsGalore! Thank you for joining our Affiliate Program.

By participating in the Program, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, you may not participate in the Program.

1. Affiliate Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate application at our discretion.

2. Affiliate Links & Coupons

Your affiliate link is automatically generated through UpPromote. You may also create links to specific products or collections.

If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links, the most recent affiliate link will receive credit for the referral.

If you are assigned a coupon code, you may promote that code. If a customer uses both your affiliate link and coupon code, only one commission will be paid.

Affiliates may promote VeilsGalore through social media, websites, blogs, email, and other appropriate online or offline channels.

3. Commissions & Payment

Commission is earned on qualifying referral sales made through your affiliate link or coupon code.

Commission: 10% normally → 12% after $500 in sales → 15% after $2,000 in sales → 18% after $5,000 in sales.

Higher commission rates apply to qualifying sales going forward after each threshold is reached and are not retroactive.

There is no minimum payout. Commissions are paid monthly on the 5th via PayPal, Cash App, or Zelle.

Commissions are based on the product purchase price and do not include taxes, shipping, or other additional fees. Refunded, canceled, fraudulent, or charged-back orders are not eligible for commission.

4. Marketing Materials

VeilsGalore may provide product images, banners, logos, or other promotional materials for affiliates to use.

5. Affiliate Network

If the Network feature is enabled, affiliates may invite others to join the program according to the terms and commission structure established by VeilsGalore.

6. Cookie & Tracking

VeilsGalore uses cookies and other tracking technology to identify referrals. If a customer blocks or clears cookies, the referral may not be tracked and a commission may not be credited.

7. Removal From the Program

VeilsGalore reserves the right to remove an affiliate from the program for violations of these Terms & Conditions, fraudulent activity, misleading advertising, or other inappropriate activity.

Affiliates may also leave the program at any time by contacting veilsgalore@gmail.com.

Questions

If you have questions about the Affiliate Program, please contact:

VeilsGalore
veilsgalore@gmail.com

Thank you for being a VeilsGalore Affiliate!
